definitions.explanation: The second day of the weekend and traditionally a day of rest. The kanji 日 means 'sun,' similar to how 'Sunday' derives from 'Sun day' in English.

examples.japanese: {日曜日|にちようび}は{家|いえ}でゆっくりします。
examples.english: On Sunday, I relax at home.

examples.japanese: {日曜日|にちようび}に{家族|かぞく}と{出|で}かけます。
examples.english: I go out with my family on Sunday.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{日曜日|にちようび}は{休|やす}みです。
examples.english: Every Sunday is a day off.

notes: Sunday uses 日 (sun), directly parallel to the English naming convention. Can be abbreviated to 日曜 (nichiyou). In Japan, Sunday is often spent with family or resting before the work week.
